description: This PHP source file defines the class ZendeskHelpProcessor, which implements the HelpProcessor interface. It manages interactions with Zendesk Help Center, including constructing URLs for search and redirection, sending HTTP queries via Guzzle, and retrieving help configuration. It is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the help plugin's processor namespace.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessor
classes.description: This class handles communication with the Zendesk help center API, including URL construction, querying, and redirection logic.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns the instance of HelpConfigService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Returns the Guzzle HTTP client instance, creating it if not already initialized.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base help URL from HelpConfigService.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs the search URL for a specific label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Determines the redirect URL based on search results for a given label.

methods.name: sendQuery
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with appropriate headers and returns the response.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the default redirect URL for Zendesk help center.
